QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_16

question.text: A research analyst and their associates shall not deal or trade in securities they recommend within:

answer.text: 7 days before and 3 days after publication of the research report
30 days before and 5 days after publication of the research report
15 days before and 15 days after publication of the research report
60 days before publication of the research report only

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 16(2) restricts a research analyst, the analyst's associates, and other covered individuals from dealing or trading in securities they recommend within a window of 30 days before and 5 days after publication of the research report. The Trap: Symmetric windows such as 15/15 or shorter windows such as 7/3 do not match the asymmetric 30/5 window in the regulation, and a 60-day-only pre-window omits the post-publication restriction altogether. Note: The restriction sits in Regulation 16(2) and is framed in terms of research analysts and their associates / covered individuals; firm-level policy may extend related restrictions to other staff but that would need a separate source.
